Skills.Name: Hydromancy
Skills.Description: Water mastery. Your soakings run 0.25 deeper, so targets stay above the thresholds that matter: 0.2 for lightning's doubled charge, 0.35 for shrugging off fire. Water deals almost no damage — it makes everything else lethal.

Powers.Name: Jet Blast
Powers.Description: Cone 2: soaks and shoves. Sets up lightning.

Powers.Name: Drench Lob
Powers.Description: Range 6, bursts radius 2. Soaks a clump early.

Powers.Name: Undertow
Powers.Description: Line 3: soaks and DRAGS them toward you.

Powers.Name: Quench
Powers.Description: A burst of conjured water: 1d3 damage in a line, range 5, soaking the target (Wet) and cooling it −150J — the setup half of the soak-then-shock grammar. Cooldown 6. Also taught by the Quench grimoire.

Powers.Name: Conjure Water
Powers.Description: Conjure a puddle up to 2 cells away — the stream seeks burning things first, soaking and dousing everything in the cell. Cooldown 4. Also taught by the Conjure Water grimoire.

Powers.Name: Conjure Rain
Powers.Description: Call polite rain over radius 3: every crop's moisture is topped up and the soil darkens. Cooldown 5. Also taught by the Watering grimoire.

Powers.Name: Drying Breeze
Powers.Description: Exhale a drying breeze: strips Wet from everything adjacent to you, yourself included. Cooldown 3. Also taught by the Drying Breeze grimoire.
